'''Network Access''' was a vital hub of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which itself was considered the technological heart of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It governed all HoloNet operations on Nar Shaddaa and much of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] with billions of transactions along with communications being processed each second by the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems. This ensured the proper functioning of communications throughout the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and Network Access boasted the galaxy's most state-of-the-art security protocols which made it the ultimate challenge for any enterprising [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]].<ref name="TORC" />

Both the wealthy and powerful paid a good amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for information [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to break into Network Access in order to recover data, redirect communications or simply alter the truth. Thus, it was considered one of the most heavily-guarded locations on Nar Shaddaa with anyone managing to infiltrate its inner workings earning the status of a legend.<ref name="TORC" />
